extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Preview Settings switch under Skin Settings, Overall, off by default. Switched on, the panel under the help text shows what the focused setting does: the Home Screen drawn live, or a picture of each value, following the value as you change it. A setting with nothing to show says so. Left off, Skin Settings looks as before. Fixed the dim settings at their no dim step. Video Dim, the Home background dim and the dim for other windows covered the screen in white at 0, in every earlier release. They now leave the picture at full brightness.
